scope: QtQuick5 disabled-control hint delivery only; seven controls in the native KDE gallery. QtQuick6 behavior was rechecked for regression.

runtime.display: Xephyr :82, host 1600x1000; isolated gallery process uses a disposable HOME and private D-Bus/network namespace

implementation.approach: QtQuick5 HoverHandlers on the relevant containing layouts map pointer coordinates to the disabled QQuickItems. A 750 ms timer reveals the existing attached native ToolTip. Leaving or changing target cancels/restarts it.
implementation.safety: The controls remain disabled; the route changes only which existing ToolTip is visible. It does not set enabled, accept a click, synthesize painting, or replace KDE palette roles.
implementation.qtquick6: Coordinate routing is disabled; its native hover path remains unchanged.

method.probe: Focused derivative of the R4 QtQuick native gallery probe; filters to visible disabled controls only and keeps cold check, tooltip geometry, stable 400 ms interval, and leave-dismiss checks.
method.runner: run_t07_qtquick_matrix_r4.py --quick with production gallery and disposable profile

qtquick5.geometry: all seven tooltip rectangles were inside the screen and did not overlap their owning control

qtquick6.geometry: all seven tooltip rectangles were inside the screen and did not overlap their owning control

integration_limit: The first broad mixed-control run was not accepted as final evidence: the probe reported early visible hints on already enabled targets during its cold check, a contamination also described in R127. Its first attempt also preceded the local Button-row handler. The final R128 claim is limited to the focused seven-disabled-control runs; no claim is made that the complete mixed QtQuick5 matrix passed.
remaining: Retest the combined enabled and disabled QtQuick5 gallery with a probe that drains stale popups between targets; R128 did not claim that mixed matrix.
T07 still has other controls/layouts, theme-role combinations, and review items listed in the inventory; this receipt does not complete T07.
next: Continue T07 with the next uncovered hint scope after the combined-matrix probe issue is documented.
